issues.title: Unresolved External Dependency: AC-CL-*
issues.why: AC-SD-01 and AC-SD-02 mandate compliance with AC-CL-01..20 from a relative path '../02-coding-guidelines/...' which is not provided in the current context.
issues.fix: Provide the content of spec/02-coding-guidelines/01-cross-language/97-acceptance-criteria.md in the context or inline the specific naming rules.

issues.title: Ambiguous 'ApplicationId' Source
issues.why: AC-SD-05 defines a Counter table using ApplicationId, but the Root DB schema in 01-fundamentals.md defines a 'Project' table with 'ProjectId' and no 'Application' table.
issues.fix: Update Root DB schema in 01-fundamentals.md to include an Application table or unify terminology to ProjectId in AC-SD-05.

issues.title: Schema/AC Discrepancy on Registry Table
issues.why: AC-SD-05 requires a registry table tracking 'SequenceNumber' and 'LastAccessedAt', but the 'Database' table schema in 01-fundamentals.md lacks a SequenceNumber column.
issues.fix: Add 'SequenceNumber INTEGER NOT NULL' to the 'Database' table DDL in 01-fundamentals.md.
